integrity: All threshold formulas are reconstructed from the printed equations. The symbolic checker verifies the equilibrium, dimensional scaling relation, predecessor/source formula relation, exact recovered-mass gap, and rational witness. The stability statement is proved from the exact Jacobian block structure.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the deterministic local disease-free threshold for equation (2.1) with the stated six-class total population. It does not independently assess the paper's stochastic extinction/persistence theorems, global nonlinear conclusions, ANN approximation, or simulations.
title: Exact correction of the double-dose measles threshold and its missing-rate factor
